emails.subject: Re: pricing for the 250-seat Acme deal
emails.body_plain:
Hi Tasha,

Thanks for the call yesterday. Looking at the proposal — the 250-seat tier looks great but procurement is asking for a 12-month NET-60 instead of the NET-30 in the contract.

Can we make that work? Trying to close before our budget cycle resets next Friday.

— Jordan

emails.subject: Re: pricing for the 250-seat Acme deal
emails.body_plain:
Tasha,

NET-60 needs VP approval per our contracting policy. Loop me in before you send any redline. Also flagging: Acme's parent company was acquired last week — we need to re-run the credit check before final signature.

I'll start the credit review now. Don't promise NET-60 in writing yet.

— Diane
